slot: Your question, plus the daily report
summary: The S&P 500 fell to 7,631.47, down 0.71%, as a one-two punch hit markets: U.S. strikes on Iranian targets in the Strait of Hormuz sent crude oil up 5.89% to 90.81 a barrel, stoking fears that higher energy costs will push inflation back up, which would force the Federal Reserve to keep interest rates high longer. The VIX, which measures how much fear is priced into the market, jumped 9.18% to 16.29. Gold fell 1.23% and Bitcoin dropped 1.53%, so there was no safe haven trade today. The big event this week is Friday's jobs report, which will tell us whether the economy is strong enough to absorb higher oil prices.
